cards.body: You wrapped Japan with a Michelin dinner, sake with a Japanese Air Force officer, and three journal entries in one day — then flew first class to Bora Bora and hit the ground running (literally). Sunday the 8th was the week's defining moment: tennis with Dave, a run, weights, sobriety intact, and nine Gremly feature tasks planned before noon. The emotional arc from 'lower energy' on Monday to 'felt very very refreshed' by Sunday is the whole story.
cards.headline: Tokyo closed perfectly. Bora Bora opened even better.

moments.body: You wrote three journal entries on Monday — all capturing the day before. Michelin dinner, matcha, Shibuya crossing, an arcade, onsen, Golden Gai cocktails, and a sake tasting where you ended up chatting with a senior member of Japan's Air Self-Defense Force. Golden Gai's fifty-metre stretch of six-seat bars is one of Tokyo's great accidents — the kind of place you can't plan your way into. 'Yesterday was like a perfect day in Tokyo' is the sentence that earns its own memory.
moments.title: The Perfect Day (Told the Morning After)

moments.body: Tennis with Dave, a run, weights, sobriety held, poolside cabana booked, and nine Gremly tasks planned — all before the day was done. You credited the long sleep: 'Felt very very refreshed this morning.' Bora Bora's lagoon sits inside one of the world's largest barrier reefs; the light at that latitude in March is genuinely different. This was the week's peak integration moment — no tension between any of your competing desires, everything happening at once.

cards.body: February ended in a pre-departure sprint — TestFlight shipped, work handed over, bags packed on fumes. March opened in Tokyo and hasn't slowed down since. The most significant shift isn't the destinations; it's the emotional one. You arrived in Japan grateful and excited. You arrived in Bora Bora refreshed and energised. And somewhere around March 12, floating on a lagoon, you made a decision about what actually matters on a once-in-a-lifetime trip. Hawaii is next — and the half marathon is waiting on the other side.

Launched TestFlight in the final days of February, then completed the entire DCO feature arc (four todos) from a Bora Bora sun lounger by March 13.
Maintained 133% completion through three countries; the half marathon on March 22 arrives as the month's fitness climax.
Dave appeared in every journal entry across the month — and by March 12, you made the conscious choice to prioritise him over your app.
